scope: Static asset comparison for the SvelteKit 3 migration; not latency, throughput or production-capacity qualification.
comparison: Same host, Node, pnpm and explicit build identifier. Baseline is the preceding source and lockfile. Framework-only candidate uses SvelteKit 3.1.0, adapter-static 4.0.0 and Svelte 5.57.2 with compatibility changes. Final candidate additionally packs translation messages in contract order. Default minification and automatic chunk splitting are retained.
notes: Both budgets are unchanged. A different source revision changes hashed assets and their exact compressed size; each build must pass the same absolute limits.
Catalog source text and runtime ICU validation are unchanged. Ordered messages remove redundant numeric indices; old and new generated assets must not be mixed.
